The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**Files in `output/`:**
- `main.js` — CLI entry point, argument parsing, orchestration
- `parser.js` — Line preprocessing, lexer, real-value evaluation, expression parsing
- `state.js` — `MachineState` class with modal groups, position, parameters
- `executor.js` — Block execution per Table 8 order; G/M code handlers; canned cycles; CRC offset (basic, linear)
- `trace.js` — `TraceBuilder` with three stepping modes (time/distance/tolerance); delta encoding
- `files.js` — Tool and parameter file I/O

**Features implemented:**
- All G-codes: G0-G4, G10, G17-G21, G28-G30, G38.2, G40-G43, G49, G53-G59.3, G61-G64, G80-G99
- All M-codes: M0-M9, M30, M48-M60, M6
- Words: X, Y, Z, A, B, C, D, F, H, I, J, K, L, P, Q, R, S, T, N
- Parameters (`#N`, `#N=...`) with parallel-assignment semantics
- Expressions, unary functions (abs, sin, cos, atan, etc.), binary operators with three precedence groups
- Comments and `(MSG, ...)` messages
- Block-delete (`/` lines) and `%` file demarcation
- Canned cycles G81-G89 with all sub-motion expansion, sticky values, L repeats, G91 incremental
- G84 tapping spindle direction transitions; G86/G87 spindle stop/start; G88 modeled per clarification
- Coordinate systems (G10 L2, G54-G59.3, G92, G92.1-3)
- Tool length compensation (G43/G49 H), basic cutter radius compensation (G40/G41/G42 D)
- Probe (G38.2) with `--probe-box` and `--probe-tool`
- Tool table and parameter file I/O in RS274 format
- Trace output with time-step, distance-step, and position-tolerance stepping
- Full delta encoding with M2/M30 reset effects, mid-line G84 spindle transitions as trailing entries
- Error handling: exit 1 for spec errors, both output and trace files written on error
